serverInfo.name: reoon-email-verifier-mcp
serverInfo.title: Reoon Email Verifier MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for Reoon Email Verifier, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many Reoon verification credits remain?"; "Quick-check jane@example.com after I confirm the credit usage."; "Submit these 20 addresses for bulk POWER verification after confirmation.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Reoon Email Verifier data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run reoon_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run reoon_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run reoon_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. reoon_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: reoon_account_balance
tools.title: Check Reoon verification credits
tools.description: Read remaining daily and instant Reoon credits without verifying an email.

tools.name: reoon_verify_email
tools.title: Quick-check an email with Reoon
tools.description: Check email syntax, domain/MX and disposable-address signals in QUICK mode. Does NOT verify inbox existence or guarantee delivery. Can spend Reoon credits; confirm:true is required. Do not run continuously in more than five parallel requests. Use bulk verification for lists.

tools.name: reoon_create_bulk_verification
tools.title: Create a Reoon bulk verification job
tools.description: Submit 10–1,000 emails for asynchronous POWER verification. Starts a vendor job and can spend verification credits. Requires confirm:true; the job may continue if the response is lost. Check the dashboard before resubmitting. Results are later read with reoon_bulk_results.

annotations.title: Create a Reoon bulk verification job

tools.name: reoon_bulk_results
tools.title: Read Reoon bulk progress and results
tools.description: Read a previously created bulk task, its progress, and a bounded page of completed email results. Does not start new verification. Wait between polls. Very large upstream exports must be downloaded in the Reoon dashboard.

annotations.title: Read Reoon bulk progress and results
